verdict.rationale: Loops publishes provider-specific migration guides for Brevo and Customer.io that move contacts and lists, plus a general migrate page that maps contacts to Loops (loops-docs-11, loops-docs-12, loops-docs-28). It also allows unlimited contact uploads on every plan and has a contact-create API (loops-docs-33, loops-docs-4). However, these guides are developer and code-oriented cutover playbooks, not a marketer-facing guided import, and nothing in the evidence says tags, custom fields or unsubscribe state carry over. Missing for 10: a guided, marketer-facing list import flow; evidence that tags and custom fields are preserved; evidence that unsubscribe and suppression state is preserved; guides beyond two providers; independent or hands-on corroboration.
